raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- With expert parallelism each rank runs only its own experts (112 of Kimi-K3's 896 at EP8).
- FlashInfer picks its routing kernel from the total expert count.
- At 896 experts, decode steps of 5-16 tokens run the multi-block cluster routing kernel.
- That costs 11-12.6 us per MoE layer, about 1 ms per decode step.

## Modifications

- The fused route+quant kernel writes rank-local ids: own experts `0..count-1`, any other expert `count + top-k slot`.
- The runner passes `num_experts = round_up(count + top_k, 4)` (128 at EP8) and offset 0.
  FlashInfer then uses its single-block routing kernel up to 16 tokens.
- The same (token, expert, weight) entries reach the expert GEMMs in the same order, so outputs do not change.
- Startup tuning also tunes the rank-local key (2-3 min more on a first start without an autotune cache).
- Applies only with EP > 1 on the fused decode path (MXFP4 trtllm-gen MoE, up to 64 tokens per step).
  EP = 1, prefill and other models are unchanged.

## Tested configurations

| | Aggregated | Prefill/decode |
|---|---|---|
| Hardware | 1 x 8x B300 | 2 x 8x B300 (1 prefill + 1 decode), KV over RDMA |
| Server | `--tp-size 8 --dcp-size 8 --ep-size 8` | prefill `--tp-size 8 --ep-size 8`, decode adds `--dcp-size 8`; sgl-router `--pd-disaggregation` |
| Builds | main @ [7591118](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/759111879457fb5acd171284dc9a8a1e6bf8c77d), with and without this change; FlashInfer 0.7.2 | same |
| Speed | `bench_one_batch_server`, input 8192, output 512 | `bench_serving`, random, input 8192, output 512 |
| Launches | 3 per build, fresh autotune each | 2 per build, fresh autotune each |
| Accuracy | GSM8K 5-shot, 1,319 questions; 16 greedy prompts token by token | - |

The PR is rebased onto current main; the unit tests pass there.

## Results

Routing kernel per MoE layer at 8 / 16 / 24 tokens: 11.1 / 12.2 / 12.6 us on main, 4.3 / 4.8 / 7.1 us with this PR.

**Kimi-K3, aggregated** (decode output tok/s, mean of 3 launches)

| | batch 8 | batch 16 | batch 32 |
|---|---|---|---|
| main @ 7591118 | 558.9 | 803.6 | 1271.5 |
| this PR | 594.0 (+6.3 %) | 873.2 (+8.7 %) | 1300.8 (+2.3 %) |

**Kimi-K3, aggregated, with #45543** (decode output tok/s, mean of 2 launches)

| | batch 8 | batch 16 | batch 24 | batch 32 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| main @ [3c56008](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/3c560089e1818a5217a73f2168273485a5350341) | 554.7 | 795.4 | 1077.1 | 1305.3 |
| #45543 | 555.2 (+0.1 %) | 856.7 (+7.7 %) | 1132.1 (+5.1 %) | 1372.4 (+5.1 %) |
| together with this PR | 592.4 (+6.8 %) | 898.9 (+13.0 %) | 1168.0 (+8.4 %) | 1397.4 (+7.1 %) |

- #45543 is independent (FlashInfer MoE startup tuning, no shared files).

**Kimi-K3, prefill/decode** (mean of 2 launches)

| output tok/s | concurrency 16 | concurrency 32 | concurrency 64 |
|---|---|---|---|
| main @ 7591118 | 761.3 | 1183.7 | 1496.1 |
| this PR | 793.2 (+4.2 %) | 1189.8 (+0.5 %) | 1498.9 (+0.2 %) |

| ITL p99 (ms) | concurrency 16 | concurrency 32 | concurrency 64 |
|---|---|---|---|
| main @ 7591118 | 32.4 | 38.4 | 42.3 |
| this PR | 28.0 (-13.6 %) | 40.2 (+4.7 %) | 41.5 (-2.0 %) |

- Decode batch at concurrency 16 / 32 / 64: about 16 / 30 / 40-44 (at 64 the prefill node is the limit).
- The saving is fixed per decode step, so it is largest at small decode batches.
- Prefill throughput and TTFT within 3 % (aggregated); memory unchanged.
- GSM8K: 0.955 (main) vs 0.950 (this PR).
- Greedy outputs identical when requests are sent one at a time (16/16); batched runs vary on main itself.
- Unit tests: routed MoE output bitwise equal for global and rank-local ids at EP 2 / 4 / 8 / 16, 1-64 tokens.

Related: #42727 covers EP = 1 for the same model; the two do not overlap.

<details><summary>Reproduce</summary>

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Venkat2811/sglang && cd sglang
git checkout fc02c949195d520340ff8997e55e2fda0b7c0a82   # this PR; measured as 7591118 + this change
pytest -q test/registered/kernels/ops/moe/test_route_quant_prerequisites.py \
  test/registered/kernels/ops/moe/test_rank_local_routed_moe.py
export SGLANG_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_CACHE=0               # fresh autotune per launch

# Aggregated
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --trust-remote-code \
  --tp-size 8 --dcp-size 8 --ep-size 8 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 \
  --linear-attn-prefill-backend triton --linear-attn-decode-backend triton --port 30000
python3 -m sglang.bench_one_batch_server --model-path moonshotai/Kimi-K3 \
  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:30000 --batch-size 8 16 32 --input-len 8192 --output-len 512
python3 -m sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k --num-questions 1319 --parallel 64 --num-shots 5 --port 30000

# Prefill/decode (IB = your RDMA devices)
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --trust-remote-code \
  --tp-size 8 --ep-size 8 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --page-size 64 \
  --linear-attn-prefill-backend triton --linear-attn-decode-backend triton \
  --disaggregation-mode prefill --disaggregation-transfer-backend mooncake \
  --disaggregation-ib-device $IB --disaggregation-bootstrap-port 8998 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000
# decode node: same command with --dcp-size 8 and --disaggregation-mode decode
python3 -m sglang_router.launch_router --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --pd-disaggregation \
  --prefill http://$PREFILL_IP:30000 8998 --decode http://$DECODE_IP:30000
for c in 16 32 64; do
  python3 -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --base-url http://$ROUTER_IP:8001 \
    --model moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --dataset-name random --random-input-len 8192 \
    --random-output-len 512 --random-range-ratio 1.0 \
    --num-prompts $((c * 16)) --max-concurrency $c --seed $c
done
```

P/D launch ranges, output tok/s: at 16, 760.6-761.9 vs 789.0-797.3; at 32, 1182.7-1184.6 vs 1186.7-1192.9;
at 64, 1494.6-1497.6 vs 1498.2-1499.6.
</details>

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -38,7 +38,7 @@
 # Fusion trades the flat quant grid for one 224-thread CTA per token; that (and
 # the win itself, which is launch overhead) only makes sense at small decode
 # batches. Above the cap the callers run the unfused chain.
-_MAX_TOKENS = 64
+MAX_TOKENS = 64
 
 
 @cache_once
@@ -84,7 +84,7 @@ def covered(
     return (
         moe_route_radix.covered(scores, bias, topk)
         and x.dim() == 2
-        and 0 < x.shape[0] <= _MAX_TOKENS
+        and 0 < x.shape[0] <= MAX_TOKENS
         and x.shape[1] == _HIDDEN
         and x.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32)
         and x.stride(1) == 1
@@ -101,11 +101,18 @@ def route_quant_fused(
     renormalize: bool,
     routed_scaling_factor: float,
     apply_scale: bool,
+    local_expert_offset: int = 0,
+    num_local_experts: int = 0,
 ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
     """Returns ``(weights [M, topk] fp32, ids [M, topk] int32, packed [M, topk]
     int32, x_q [M, 3584] fp8_e4m3, x_s [M, 28] int32 row-major packed UE8M0)``.
     Caller must have checked covered(). Winners come out in expert-id-ascending
-    order (the standalone production dispatch's sorted=False)."""
+    order (the standalone production dispatch's sorted=False).
+
+    With ``num_local_experts > 0`` the packed ids are rank-local: experts
+    ``[local_expert_offset, local_expert_offset + num_local_experts)`` become
+    ``0..num_local_experts-1`` and any other expert in slot ``k`` becomes
+    ``num_local_experts + k``. ``ids`` keeps the global ids."""
     M = scores.shape[0]
     device = scores.device
     out_w = torch.empty((M, topk), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
@@ -126,5 +133,7 @@ def route_quant_fused(
         float(routed_scaling_factor),
         bool(renormalize),
         bool(apply_scale),
+        int(local_expert_offset),
+        int(num_local_experts),
     )
     return out_w, out_i, out_packed, out_q, out_s

@@ -1071,6 +1071,102 @@ class FlashInferTrtllmGenMxfp4MoeQuantInfo(MoeQuantInfo):
     routing_bias: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
 
 
+def _flashinfer_autotune_active() -> bool:
+    from flashinfer.autotuner import AutoTuner
+
+    return AutoTuner.get().is_tuning_mode
+
+
+def _rank_local_num_experts(
+    quant_info: FlashInferTrtllmGenMxfp4MoeQuantInfo,
+    top_k: int,
+    *,
+    taken: Optional[tuple[int, int]],
+) -> Optional[int]:
+    """num_experts for packed ids the fused route made rank-local (``taken``,
+    from route_quant_handoff.take_local_experts), None for global ids."""
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe import route_quant_handoff
+
+    if taken is None:
+        return None
+    assert taken == (quant_info.local_expert_offset, quant_info.local_num_experts), (
+        taken,
+        quant_info.local_expert_offset,
+        quant_info.local_num_experts,
+    )
+    num_experts = route_quant_handoff.rank_local_num_experts(
+        *taken, quant_info.global_num_experts, top_k
+    )
+    assert num_experts is not None, (taken, quant_info.global_num_experts, top_k)
+    return num_experts
+
+
+def _tune_rank_local_routing(
+    routing: FlashInferRouting,
+    x_quant: torch.Tensor,
+    x_scale: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    quant_info: FlashInferTrtllmGenMxfp4MoeQuantInfo,
+) -> None:
+    """Decode batches within the fused route's token cap reach FlashInfer with
+    rank-local ids, a separate tuner key (num_experts) that the decode-shaped
+    autotune forward misses when it runs above the cap. Tune it from this
+    forward's routes, relabelled as the fused route would."""
+    from flashinfer.fused_moe import trtllm_fp4_block_scale_routed_moe
+    from flashinfer.tllm_enums import ActivationType, RoutingMethodType
+
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.moe_route_quant_fused import MAX_TOKENS
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe import route_quant_handoff
+
+    if not isinstance(routing, tuple) or x_scale is None or x_scale.dim() != 2:
+        return
+    topk_ids, topk_weights = routing
+    top_k = topk_ids.shape[1]
+    offset, count = quant_info.local_expert_offset, quant_info.local_num_experts
+    num_experts = route_quant_handoff.rank_local_num_experts(
+        offset, count, quant_info.global_num_experts, top_k
+    )
+    if num_experts is None:
+        return
+    rows = min(topk_ids.shape[0], MAX_TOKENS)
+    local = topk_ids[:rows].to(torch.int32) - offset
+    slot = torch.arange(top_k, device=local.device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    ids = torch.where((local >= 0) & (local < count), local, count + slot)
+    bits = topk_weights[:rows].to(torch.bfloat16).view(torch.int16).to(torch.int32)
+    trtllm_fp4_block_scale_routed_moe(
+        topk_ids=(ids << 16) | (bits & 0xFFFF),
+        routing_bias=None,
+        hidden_states=x_quant[:rows],
+        hidden_states_scale=x_scale[:rows],
+        gemm1_weights=quant_info.w13_weight,
+        gemm1_weights_scale=quant_info.w13_weight_scale,
+        gemm1_bias=None,
+        gemm1_alpha=quant_info.gemm1_alpha,
+        gemm1_beta=quant_info.gemm1_clamp_limit,
+        gemm1_clamp_limit=None,
+        gemm2_weights=quant_info.w2_weight,
+        gemm2_weights_scale=quant_info.w2_weight_scale,
+        gemm2_bias=None,
+        output1_scale_scalar=None,
+        output1_scale_gate_scalar=None,
+        output2_scale_scalar=None,
+        num_experts=num_experts,
+        top_k=top_k,
+        n_group=None,
+        topk_group=None,
+        intermediate_size=quant_info.intermediate_size_per_partition,
+        local_expert_offset=0,
+        local_num_experts=count,
+        routed_scaling_factor=None,
+        routing_method_type=RoutingMethodType.TopK.value,
+        activation_type=ActivationType.Situ.value,
+        tune_max_num_tokens=next_power_of_2(rows),
+        # same output and finalize mode as the decode call, so the same tuner key
+        output=x_quant.new_empty((rows, x_quant.shape[1]), dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        do_finalize=not _deferred_finalize_enabled.get(),
+        enable_pdl=trtllm_moe_enable_pdl(rows),
+    )
+
+
 def _fused_experts_flashinfer_mxfp4_sm100_trtllm_gen(
     dispatch_output: StandardDispatchOutput,
     quant_info: FlashInferTrtllmGenMxfp4MoeQuantInfo,
@@ -1158,6 +1254,20 @@ def _fused_experts_flashinfer_mxfp4_sm100_trtllm_gen(
                 else _get_routing_for_flashinfer_routed(topk_output)
             )

+"""Rank-local packed ids give FlashInfer's routed MXFP4 MoE the same output.
+
+Under EP the fused Kimi-K3 route+quant launch can write the rank's experts as
+0..count-1 and any other expert as count + slot, and the runner then passes
+num_experts = count + top_k with offset 0. That only changes which routing-kernel
+tier FlashInfer runs; the (token, local expert, weight) entries reaching the
+GEMMs, and so the output, must stay bitwise equal to the global-id call. Needs
+SM100 for the trtllm-gen MoE; weights are random bytes, which is enough to
+compare two routings of the same layer.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.moe import moe_route_quant_fused
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.route_quant_handoff import rank_local_num_experts

+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase

+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+NUM_EXPERTS = 896
+TOPK = 16
+HIDDEN = 3584
+INTERMEDIATE = 384
+
+
+class TestRankLocalRoutedMoe(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+            raise unittest.SkipTest("CUDA is not available")
+        if get_device_sm() < 100:
+            raise unittest.SkipTest("trtllm-gen routed MoE requires SM100+")
+        if not moe_route_quant_fused.available():
+            raise unittest.SkipTest("fused route+quant kernel unavailable")
+
+    def test_routed_moe_output_unchanged(self):
+        from flashinfer.fused_moe import trtllm_fp4_block_scale_routed_moe
+        from flashinfer.tllm_enums import RoutingMethodType
+
+        local_entries = 0
+        for ep_size in (2, 4, 8, 16):
+            count = NUM_EXPERTS // ep_size
+            g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(ep_size)
+
+            def rand_bytes(*shape, low=0, high=256):
+                return torch.randint(
+                    low, high, shape, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8, generator=g
+                )
+
+            # e2m1 weights are any byte; UE8M0 scales 2^-10..2^-6 keep it finite
+            w13 = rand_bytes(count, 2 * INTERMEDIATE, HIDDEN // 2)
+            w13_scale = rand_bytes(
+                count, 2 * INTERMEDIATE, HIDDEN // 32, low=117, high=122
+            )
+            w2 = rand_bytes(count, HIDDEN, INTERMEDIATE // 2)
+            w2_scale = rand_bytes(count, HIDDEN, INTERMEDIATE // 32, low=117, high=122)
+
+            def moe(packed, x_q, x_s, num_experts, local_expert_offset):
+                out = torch.empty(
+                    packed.shape[0], HIDDEN, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+                )
+                trtllm_fp4_block_scale_routed_moe(
+                    topk_ids=packed,
+                    routing_bias=None,
+                    hidden_states=x_q,
+                    hidden_states_scale=x_s.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+                    gemm1_weights=w13,
+                    gemm1_weights_scale=w13_scale.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+                    gemm1_bias=None,
+                    gemm1_alpha=None,
+                    gemm1_beta=None,
+                    gemm1_clamp_limit=None,
+                    gemm2_weights=w2,
+                    gemm2_weights_scale=w2_scale.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+                    gemm2_bias=None,
+                    output1_scale_scalar=None,
+                    output1_scale_gate_scalar=None,
+                    output2_scale_scalar=None,
+                    num_experts=num_experts,
+                    top_k=TOPK,
+                    n_group=None,
+                    topk_group=None,
+                    intermediate_size=INTERMEDIATE,
+                    local_expert_offset=local_expert_offset,
+                    local_num_experts=count,
+                    routed_scaling_factor=None,
+                    routing_method_type=RoutingMethodType.TopK.value,
+                    output=out,
+                )
+                return out
+
+            for rank in sorted({0, ep_size // 2, ep_size - 1}):
+                offset = rank * count
+                # FlashInfer routing: block kernel up to 4 tokens, dyn-block or
+                # cluster up to 16, cluster above; 64 is the fused launch's cap
+                for num_tokens in (1, 4, 5, 8, 16, 17, 24, 64):

+                    _, ids, packed, x_q, x_s = moe_route_quant_fused.route_quant_fused(

+                    local_packed = moe_route_quant_fused.route_quant_fused(

+        self.assertGreater(local_entries, 0)

+    unittest.main()
